question: Why does differentiated awareness arise if knowerhood is full?
premises: Differentiated forms of awareness arise from nonseparation from concealment of some part of that fullness.
Thus differentiation does not negate the underlying fullness.
inference: Even when knowerhood is full, differentiated awareness appears because some aspect of that fullness is not separated from concealment.
plain_english: Thus full knowerhood shines forth equally; yet differentiated forms of awareness arise from not being separated from the concealment of some part of that fullness.
